locators_probed_against_live_page: 2026-09-08 -- all correct_primary and wrong entries confirmed by direct vibium find_all calls
note: Hand-authored from the live DOM. Never derive this from an element-map -- a target built from the system under test cannot detect errors that system makes consistently.

tiers.correct_primary: semantic, uniquely resolving by design. Allowed as primary.
tiers.acceptable_fallback: resolves reliably but non-semantic. Allowed only as documented fallback, never primary.
tiers.wrong: does not resolve, or resolves only by accident of current page state.

elements.name: loginButton
elements.accessible_name_source: value attribute of <input type=submit>, per HTML-AAM
elements.html: <input class="submit-button btn_action" data-test="login-button" id="login-button" type="submit" value="Login" name="login-button">

wrong_because.role=button: count=1 only because it is the sole button on this page; the auth-gate error state already shows count=2. Unique by circumstance, not by design.
wrong_because.text=Login: count=0 -- 'Login' lives in the value attribute, not a text node
wrong_because.testid=login-button: count=0 -- vibium's testid targets data-testid; this site uses data-test
wrong_because..submit-button: styling class, changes with any redesign
wrong_because..btn_action: styling class, changes with any redesign

elements.testability_gap_because: role=button,label=Login resolves to exactly 1 by design. The unreachable data-test attribute is a vibium limitation, not a page defect.

open_questions: This target asserts testability_gap=false for all 3 elements, which disagrees with 4 of the 8 runs. That is the intended outcome of defining the term: a gap means no correct_primary exists.

RESOLVED 2026-09-08: role=textbox is count=2 in vibium -- it matches input[type=password], unlike Playwright's getByRole. All 8 traces were correct. Note the engines differ, so a locator graded correct here is not automatically correct in the generated Playwright suite.
RESOLVED 2026-09-08: class="input_error" is present in the clean state (confirmed by screenshot). Misleading name, permanent class, still wrong as a locator.
